## BaanDee Stock Planner
1. Import the four CSV tabs into Google Sheets.
2. Set Spreadsheet ID on all Google Sheets nodes.
3. Select your existing Google Sheets credential on all nodes.
4. Use a protected webhook before public use.
5. Publish and set N8N_WEBHOOK_URL on the local UI.
Single-operator prototype: Sheets writes are not atomic.
